summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with numpy and torch.nn.functional imports) and added the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias. Exported the class from monai/losses/__init__.py. Added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty-class tests. Nothing was run, per instructions; verification was by reading the code and hand-checking the batch-of-two example (TP 0.8, D 2.4, loss about 0.333). The cross-sample TP and D are computed as a per-voxel sum over samples, which is mathematically equivalent to the spec's pairwise form but costs O(batch x voxels). Nothing is committed.
